top_signals.title: Shrinking Chinese Fuel Inventories Raise Chance of Export Curbs
top_signals.summary: China’s gasoline and diesel inventories are plunging as refiners grapple with a tightening domestic market, raising the chance the government may move to limit fuel exports again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
top_signals.summary: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S. Supreme Court rejects Trump’s mail ballot curbs for midterms
top_signals.summary: Monday's came after North Carolina and Alabama began mailing ballots to voters and many more states prepared to do the same in the coming days.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
